subject: New York City Events — October 23–31, 2026
intro: New York’s first October 23–31 guide spans all five boroughs: civic-AI sessions and a Columbia AI conference, Knicks basketball, art at Central Park’s Arsenal Gallery, free neighborhood 5Ks, and Halloween events from Staten Island to the Village. Check each organizer’s current entry, registration and schedule details; some AI meetups require approval and share their addresses only after RSVP. The Strand Book Store is the business spotlight, and New York Cares is the community spotlight. The AI Ethics reading list pairs NYC guidance and hiring rules with a book about algorithmic hiring.

events.title: BetaBagels 017: Building Civic AI for NYC’s Open Government
events.description: A free virtual session on checking AI answers about New York City and State government. BetaNYC will demonstrate CivicAITools.org and its connections to public data, including Council legislation, city contracts and 311. Register with the organizer.

events.title: Spooky Civic AI Hackathon: Build Weekend
events.date: Friday–Saturday, Oct 23–24; 11:00 AM Friday–5:00 PM Saturday
events.venue: New York City or online — in-person address shared after registration
events.description: A free build weekend focused on tools that help New Yorkers. The organizer says physical-AI teams begin at 11:00 AM Friday and other tracks start with a 6:00 PM kickoff. Virtual tickets are open without approval; limited in-person places are approved on a rolling basis.

events.title: NYRR Open Run: Astoria Park
events.description: A free weekly 5K community run. Walkers and runners of all ages, abilities and experience levels are welcome; check the NYC Parks listing for course and arrival details.

events.title: NYRR Open Run: Soundview Park
events.venue: Lafayette Avenue and Morrison Avenue entrance, Soundview Park, Bronx
events.description: A free weekly 5K community run in Soundview Park. NYC Parks lists the event as open to runners and walkers; check the organizer page for course and arrival details.

events.title: New York Knicks vs. Orlando Magic
events.description: The Knicks host the Orlando Magic at Madison Square Garden. Check the official game page for ticket availability and entry information.
events.source: NBA and New York Knicks official game listing

events.title: State of AI 2026 — NYC Launch
events.venue: Midtown South, Manhattan — exact address shared after registration
events.description: Air Street’s New York launch of the 2026 State of AI report, with report author Nathan Benaich and guest speaker Ara Kharazian of Ramp. Registration requests require host approval, and the organizer requires a physical government ID for entry.
events.source: Air Street events official Luma event listing

events.title: New York Knicks vs. Detroit Pistons
events.description: The Knicks host Detroit at Madison Square Garden. Check the official game page for ticket availability and entry information.
events.source: NBA and New York Knicks official game listing

events.title: New Dendrology at the Arsenal Gallery
events.date: Wednesday, Oct 28 at 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EDT
events.description: A free group exhibition by eleven artists exploring trees and the human relationship with urban nature. NYC Parks lists weekday gallery hours through November 6; check the page for visitor information.

events.title: Daytona AI Builders — NYC
events.venue: New York City — exact address shared after registration
events.description: An AI-engineering evening with talks on long-running agents, forkable development environments and multi-agent systems. Registration requests require host approval; the organizer shares the venue after registration.

events.title: NYC Council Committee on Small Business Hearing
events.description: A City Council committee meeting held jointly with the Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education. Review the official agenda and current attendance or viewing information before going.
events.source: New York City Council official meeting calendar

events.title: Negotiation Transformed? AI in Bargaining and its Broader Implications
events.date: Friday, Oct 30 at 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EDT
events.venue: David Geffen Hall, 3rd Floor, Columbia Business School, Manhattan
events.description: A multidisciplinary conference on how generative AI is changing negotiation, work, organizations and legal systems. Registration and event details are available from Columbia’s Data Science Institute.
events.source: Columbia University Data Science Institute official event listing

events.title: Hippo Playground Halloween Parade
events.venue: Soldiers’ and Sailors’ Monument, Riverside Park, Manhattan
events.description: A free neighborhood Halloween parade for costumed children, with Ramblin’ Dan’s Freewheelin’ Band. Check NYC Parks for gathering details and any updates.

events.title: Village Halloween Parade
events.venue: Sixth Avenue, from Canal Street to 15th Street, Manhattan
events.description: The annual nighttime parade begins at Canal Street and Sixth Avenue and travels north to 15th Street. Only people in costume may march; the organizer lists a 6:30–9:00 PM lineup window and advises using public transit.
events.source: Village Halloween Parade official organizer page

events.title: Creepy Crawly Halloween
events.date: Saturday, Oct 31 at 10:00 AM–4:00 PM EDT
events.venue: Audubon Center at the Boathouse, Prospect Park, Brooklyn
events.description: A free Halloween event at Prospect Park’s nature center. Check NYC Parks for the day’s activities, entry details and accessibility information.

events.title: Pumpkin Palooza
events.venue: Basketball Courts, St. Mary’s Park, Bronx
events.description: A free NYC Parks Halloween gathering with crafts, inflatables, games, music and pumpkin picking. The official listing says it is open to the public; check for updates before leaving.

events.title: Greenbelt’s Haunted Trail
events.venue: Lower Parking Lot, Greenbelt Recreation Center, Staten Island
events.description: A free family Halloween event presented by NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation. The official listing describes a haunted trail, with bigger frights beginning at 6:00 PM.

events.title: The Strand Book Store
events.date: Business spotlight — open daily, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM
events.description: An independent, family-run New York bookstore founded in 1927, with more than 2.5 million new, used and rare books across its flagship shelves. Check the store’s site for current hours and in-store events.

events.title: New York Cares
events.date: Community spotlight — explore current volunteer opportunities
events.description: A citywide volunteer organization that mobilizes New Yorkers to meet community needs, including education, hunger and homelessness, health, and care for parks and gardens. Browse current projects and volunteer requirements on its site.
events.source: New York Cares official About page
